objective: Test whether one dense, causally completed balance-to-displacement ML state plus anti-martingale same-position additions can convert rare crypto trends into broad, after-cost NAV growth materially above the current first place without adding to losers.

market_scope.execution_proxy: Binance USD-M perpetual 5-minute OHLCV and taker-buy quote volume; a survivor requires later Bybit-native replay

single_event_definition.breakout: completed close beyond the shifted 24-bar high or low
single_event_definition.cooldown: per-symbol candidate labels do not overlap; next candidate starts only after the prior label resolves

initial_invalidation_and_label.stop: breakout-bar opposite extreme plus 0.10 slow ATR adverse buffer
initial_invalidation_and_label.R: absolute next-open entry to frozen stop distance
initial_invalidation_and_label.positive_label: directional +2R is touched before the frozen -1R stop
initial_invalidation_and_label.negative_label: the frozen stop is touched first
initial_invalidation_and_label.economic_entry_rule_at_cost: calibrated p*2R - (1-p)*1R - initial round-trip cost in R must be positive

model.calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on the calibration partition

payoff.unit_1: enter once after positive calibrated structural EV
payoff.unit_2: after a completed close at or beyond +1R, move the shared stop to initial entry and add one unit at the next open; size only the new unit to 0.5% current NAV risk to the shared stop
payoff.unit_3: after a completed close at or beyond +2R, move the shared stop to +1R and add one unit at the next open; size only the new unit to 0.5% current NAV risk to the shared stop
payoff.after_full_pyramid_trail: shared stop ratchets with the shifted prior six completed 30-minute lows for long or highs for short, never loosens
payoff.exit: all units exit only at the shared structural stop; no elapsed-time liquidation
payoff.baseline: same ML-selected entries and stop ratchet but only unit 1

winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% of accepted confirmation event keys, then rerun global-slot arbitration and both payoff paths
decision_if_fail: Retire this exact dense balance-displacement plus anti-martingale payoff. Do not tune adjacent lookbacks, compression, body, model, add levels, trail, risk or leverage.
decision_if_pass: Freeze the 2023-fitted model and exact payoff, then open only 2024H1 as the first official causal interval with a separately added actual-funding and Bybit execution replay requirement before ranking.
